text:
Maya: quick pulse — OptKit delivery status. We pushed quant recs for rw-7b to the staging branch yesterday but seeing ~8% latency regressions on short prompts. Anyone owning rollout today?

Eli: I can take ownership for canary rollout. filing checklist now. @Samir can you confirm the PR with the kv-cache changes is ready for review? :eyes:

Samir: PR is up: https://git.redwood/optkit/pulls/482 — tests pass locally but CI flaked on batch-smoke. I haven't added the fallback knob yet (will do in next hour).

Lin: infra note — staging GPU pool is at 82% right now. If canary runs at 16 batch we may oversub. Suggest start at batch=8 and ramp.

Maya: good call. Eli — plan: start canary batch=8, kv_cache=true, monitor p95 + regression alert. If stable -> ramp to 16.

Eli: ack. creating canary with this config. Posting config snippet for ops and SRE:```yaml
model: rw-7b-q4
batch: 8
kv_cache: true
quant_profile: conservative
metrics: [p50, p95, error_rate]
canary_percent: 5
```

qa-bot: Regression check job scheduled: /jobs/reg-check optkit-quant v2 -> will report in ~12m.

Samir: adding fallback knob to PR (optkit/config/canary.yaml) so we can flip kv_cache=false if regressions persist. pinging reviewers (maya, eli).

Maya: also saw two embeddings regressions in yesterday's run — I opened an eval set ticket: https://tickets.redwood/EV-129. Please add those prompts to the canary evaluation set.

Eli: will add EV-129 prompts. Starting canary now (5% traffic -> batch=8). Will post p95 and token-cost after 10m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary started by Eli on cluster-staging-3 (id: c-9082). 5% traffic -> 4 instances.

Samir: CI rerun passed after rerun. PR link above updated with fallback flag.

qa-bot: Reg-check finished: p95 increased 7.6% vs baseline, error_rate stable. Full diff attached to EV-129.

Maya: thanks. Eli — hold ramp. Samir — if we can add a micro-optim to kv access pattern (small change) that might drop p95 ~3-4%. Can you prototype?

Samir: I'll try micro-optim in a branch and bench locally. If it helps I'll push a hotfix PR. ETA 3h.

Eli: keeping canary at 5% and batch=8. Notifying partners: @product @support about hold.

Maya: thanks team. We'll reconvene async in ~3h or earlier if samir posts results. If regression stays >5% we'll flip to quant_profile: safe and re-run.

Eli: noted. Will also capture token-cost delta to populate the cost/latency tradeoff in the rollout notes.

Maya: Closing the loop: owners = Eli (canary ops), Samir (kv micro-optim + PR), Lin (infra capacity), Maya (release decision + eval triage).
